profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | MS in Computer Information Systems | Cybersecurity, Backend Systems, and Enterprise Applications
profile.summary:
I recently completed my Master of Science in Computer Information Systems, building upon more than 8 years of experience developing and supporting enterprise applications in PCI-compliant environments.
Throughout my professional and academic journey, I have focused on full-stack development, backend systems, cybersecurity practices, and enterprise solution design. My experience includes developing scalable platform components, improving operational efficiency through automation, and collaborating across cross-functional teams to deliver secure and reliable systems.
In parallel with my graduate studies, I expanded my focus into cybersecurity through hands-on learning, security-focused projects, and industry certifications, including ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC) and CompTIA Security+. One of the most rewarding milestones during my master’s program was completing a capstone project that integrated OpenVAS with a custom Flask API to automate vulnerability scanning workflows, centralized logging with Seq, and MongoDB-based data management, all deployed in a Dockerized environment.
Key areas of interest and experience include:
• Cybersecurity and secure software development
• Vulnerability assessment and system monitoring
• Backend engineering and enterprise application development
• API integration and automation
• System observability, logging, and diagnostics
• Cloud-native and containerized solutions
I take pride in continuously improving my technical capabilities and applying what I learn to practical, real-world challenges. Completing my graduate degree represents an important personal and professional achievement, and I look forward to continuing to grow and evolve within the technology and cybersecurity space.
